title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #12

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about God and human beings is true? (1 mark)
   A. God knows only adults
   B. God knows each person by name
   C. God knows only the leaders
   D. God has forgotten small children

2. Why is it good to name your feeling, such as saying "I am angry"? (1 mark)
   A. It helps you to decide what to do about it
   B. It is a sin
   C. It makes others angry
   D. It makes the feeling bigger

3. Which choice is likely to bring a good result? (1 mark)
   A. Copying from a friend
   B. Telling a lie
   C. Doing homework before playing
   D. Skipping class

4. Who is your cousin? (1 mark)
   A. Your teacher
   B. Your mother's sister
   C. The child of your aunt or uncle
   D. Your father's father

5. Which Bible passage tells children to obey their parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Ephesians 6:1-3
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. John 3:16
   D. Luke 1:37

6. Why should Christians respect their bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Because it is fashionable
   B. Because of money
   C. The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   D. Because they are proud

7. Which Old Testament chapter tells the sad story of Tamar? (1 mark)
   A. Psalm 23
   B. 2 Samuel 13
   C. Exodus 20
   D. Genesis 12

8. Which verse says that there is no one holy like the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Galatians 5:22
   C. Isaiah 49:16
   D. 1 Samuel 2:2

9. What did the donkey say to Balaam? (1 mark)
   A. What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   B. Give me water
   C. Please go home
   D. I am tired

10. Who opened the donkey's mouth? (1 mark)
   A. The angel of the king
   B. Balak
   C. Balaam
   D. The Lord

11. What did God first tell Balaam about going with Balak's messengers? (1 mark)
   A. Curse Israel
   B. Take a gift
   C. Go at once
   D. Do not go with them

12. Why is the birth of Jesus unique? (1 mark)
   A. He was born in Egypt
   B. He was born in a rich home
   C. He was born in a palace
   D. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit

13. Which angel appeared to Mary? (1 mark)
   A. Raphael
   B. Michael
   C. Gabriel
   D. Peter

14. Which verse in Luke says that John would go before the Lord to prepare His way? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:76
   B. Luke 7:14
   C. Luke 19:5
   D. Luke 15:8

15. What should we do when we face problems? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Give up
   C. Hide
   D. Pray and ask for help

16. What does sharing at school help to build? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Selfishness
   C. Kindness and unity
   D. Jealousy

17. What does the parable teach about every person? (1 mark)
   A. Every person is precious to God
   B. Only adults matter
   C. Nobody matters
   D. Only rich people matter

18. What does "evangelise" mean? (1 mark)
   A. To cook
   B. To plant seeds
   C. To build
   D. To tell others the good news about Jesus

19. What did Jesus say a person must be born of? (1 mark)
   A. Bread and wine
   B. Fire and wind
   C. Earth and sky
   D. Water and the Spirit

20. Who baptised Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. John the Baptist
   B. Peter
   C. Stephen
   D. Paul

21. Which verse says that those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Psalm 125:1
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. John 3:16

22. What did Joseph say about doing the wrong thing? (1 mark)
   A. Maybe later
   B. How could I sin against God?
   C. It is fun
   D. I do not care

23. How should we tell the truth? (1 mark)
   A. Loudly
   B. Rudely
   C. With love and respect
   D. To hurt

24. Which commandment forbids false testimony? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:15
   B. Exodus 20:3
   C. Exodus 20:12
   D. Exodus 20:16

25. What is a lie? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A prayer
   C. A false statement told to deceive
   D. A true story

26. Which command did Jesus give in John 13:34? (1 mark)
   A. Go to the temple
   B. Fast
   C. Love one another
   D. Give money

27. Which of these is harmful to the body? (1 mark)
   A. Alcohol and drugs
   B. Sleep
   C. Water
   D. Vegetables

28. Which helps you to avoid situations that lead to sin? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring parents
   B. Choosing good friends
   C. Going to wrong places
   D. Keeping bad secrets

29. Which behaviour shows respect for the church? (1 mark)
   A. Littering
   B. Running
   C. Shouting
   D. Entering quietly

30. What did Jesus say the temple should be called? (1 mark)
   A. A market
   B. A school
   C. A palace
   D. A house of prayer

31. Who preached to the crowd at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. Stephen
   B. Judas
   C. Thomas
   D. Peter

32. Which disciple was a tax collector? (1 mark)
   A. Philip
   B. Matthew
   C. Peter
   D. Andrew

33. About how many people were baptised that day? (1 mark)
   A. Three thousand
   B. Thirty
   C. Three
   D. Three hundred

34. When can Christians pray? (1 mark)
   A. Only on Sunday
   B. Only at night
   C. Only in church
   D. Any time and anywhere

35. Which fruit means being gentle and careful with people's feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Gentleness
   B. Pride
   C. Envy
   D. Greed

36. What does "keep in step with the Spirit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Run fast
   B. Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   C. Dance
   D. Walk in a line

37. What should you do if someone offers you a harmful drug? (1 mark)
   A. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   B. Sell it
   C. Try it
   D. Hide it

38. What does defile mean? (1 mark)
   A. To make unclean or harm
   B. To praise
   C. To clean
   D. To help

39. Who should give permission before you use an app? (1 mark)
   A. Your parent or guardian
   B. A stranger
   C. Nobody
   D. A friend

40. Which of these should you not share? (1 mark)
   A. A Bible verse
   B. A school notice
   C. Private pictures of yourself
   D. A gospel song

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State three lessons from the story of Zacchaeus. (3 marks)

42. State three qualities of Mary that a child can copy. (3 marks)

43. Describe what happened on the road when Balaam was riding his donkey. (4 marks)

44. Give two things that make each person unique. (2 marks)

45. List six of the twelve disciples. (3 marks)

46. Explain what the Lord's Prayer teaches about forgiveness and protection. (5 marks)

47. Give three ways of avoiding situations that lead to sin. (3 marks)

48. Name two personal items and one way of caring for each. (2 marks)

49. Explain the steps a child can take to turn away from wrong behaviour, using Zacchaeus as an example. (5 marks)

50. Name two digital devices used at home or school. (2 marks)

51. State two reasons why we should tell the truth. (2 marks)

52. Describe how Stephen died. (3 marks)

53. State two ways of helping the kingdom of God to grow. (2 marks)

54. List three school rules and give a reason for each. (3 marks)

55. Describe three steps in planting and caring for a seed. (3 marks)

56. Name two fruits of the Spirit and give an example of each. (2 marks)

57. State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation. (4 marks)

58. Explain why the body is called a temple of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

59. Describe four ways in which children can serve in church. (4 marks)

60. State two ways in which Bartimaeus showed faith in Jesus. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — God knows each person by name
   Isaiah 43:1 says that God calls His people by name.

2. A — It helps you to decide what to do about it
   Naming feelings makes them easier to handle.

3. C — Doing homework before playing
   Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

4. C — The child of your aunt or uncle
   Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

5. A — Ephesians 6:1-3
   Ephesians 6:1-3 tells children to obey and honour their parents.

6. C — The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

7. B — 2 Samuel 13
   The story of Tamar is in 2 Samuel 13.

8. D — 1 Samuel 2:2
   1 Samuel 2:2 declares God's holiness.

9. A — What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?
   Numbers 22:28 records the donkey's question.

10. D — The Lord
   The Lord made the donkey speak.

11. D — Do not go with them
   God told him not to go and not to curse the people.

12. D — He was conceived by the Holy Spirit
   Jesus was conceived by the power of the Holy Spirit.

13. C — Gabriel
   Luke 1:26 says God sent the angel Gabriel.

14. A — Luke 1:76
   Luke 1:76-79 speaks about John's task.

15. D — Pray and ask for help
   We can bring our worries to God and to trusted adults.

16. C — Kindness and unity
   Sharing builds love and friendship.

17. A — Every person is precious to God
   God searches for each person.

18. D — To tell others the good news about Jesus
   Evangelising means sharing the gospel.

19. D — Water and the Spirit
   John 3:5 says this.

20. A — John the Baptist
   Matthew 3:13-17 says John baptised Jesus.

21. B — Psalm 125:1
   Psalm 125:1 gives this picture.

22. B — How could I sin against God?
   Genesis 39:9 records his answer.

23. C — With love and respect
   Truth should be told kindly.

24. D — Exodus 20:16
   Exodus 20:16 forbids false testimony.

25. C — A false statement told to deceive
   A lie is not true and is told to deceive.

26. C — Love one another
   Jesus said to love as He loved.

27. A — Alcohol and drugs
   Drugs and alcohol harm the body.

28. B — Choosing good friends
   Good friends help us do right.

29. D — Entering quietly
   Quiet respect honours God's house.

30. D — A house of prayer
   Matthew 21:13 says, "My house will be called a house of prayer."

31. D — Peter
   Peter spoke boldly.

32. B — Matthew
   Matthew was a tax collector.

33. A — Three thousand
   Acts 2:41.

34. D — Any time and anywhere
   God hears us always.

35. A — Gentleness
   Gentleness is caring.

36. B — Follow the Spirit's guidance each day
   Galatians 5:25.

37. A — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

38. A — To make unclean or harm
   Defile means to harm or make unclean.

39. A — Your parent or guardian
   Ask an adult first.

40. C — Private pictures of yourself
   Never share private pictures.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves everyone, even those others reject; repentance means changing and putting things right; we should be honest with money and share with the poor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trust in God, obedience, humility, purity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: The angel stood in the road. The donkey turned into a field and Balaam struck her. Then she pressed against a wall and crushed his foot, and he struck her again. Then she lay down and he struck her a third time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the angel, 1 for turning aside, 1 for the wall and foot, 1 for lying down.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fingerprints, voice, face, talents, likes and dislikes. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid answer.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each two correct names up to 3 marks.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: We ask God to forgive us as we forgive others, so we must forgive. We ask Him to lead us away from temptation and to deliver us from evil, so we depend on His protection and try to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's forgiveness, 1 for forgiving others, 1 for temptation, 1 for evil, 1 for depending on God.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose good friends, avoid wrong places, be careful about what you watch, keep busy with good things, pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Uniform: wash it; exercise book: cover it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with care.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Admit the wrong; be sorry and tell God; say sorry to the person hurt; put things right as Zacchaeus repaid; decide not to repeat and ask God for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, and a clear link to Zacchaeus.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Phone, tablet, computer, TV, radio.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: God commands it; people trust us; we feel peaceful; friendships stay strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: The people were furious at his message, dragged him out of the city and stoned him. He prayed for God to receive his spirit and to forgive them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for anger, 1 for stoning, 1 for prayer.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: Good example, prayer, inviting friends to church, sharing Bible stories.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Arrive on time, so lessons are not disturbed; keep quiet in class, so all can learn; do not fight, so all are safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with a reason.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dig a hole, plant the seed and cover it, water it regularly, protect it, watch it grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Love: sharing lunch; kindness: helping a friend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each fruit with example.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, so the body is holy like a temple and should be treated with respect.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Holy Spirit, 1 for holy, 1 for respect.

59. (4 marks)
   Answer: Sing in the choir, help clean, welcome visitors, read a verse, take the offering, help in Sunday school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: He called out to Jesus; he kept shouting when told to be quiet; he came at once; he asked for sight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
